'''Kron''' was an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], he was acting as ambassador to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] from Alderaan. He was trapped on Naboo during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] and ensuing invasion of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. A dying Naboo palace guard gave a group of unidentified heroes a diplomatic pouch bearing the [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] seal with the instructions that it was vital that it be given to Ambassador Kron.
